Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the main function of photosynthetic cells. While stomata (guard cells) regulate gas exchange (Option D), the primary biological function of photosynthetic cells (containing chloroplasts) is to perform photosynthesis, which converts light energy into chemical energy (food). The Planner confused the regulatory mechanism of gas intake with the core metabolic function of the cells themselves, leading to the wrong conclusion (D) instead of the correct answer (C).
